D5/S1/Deficit/Beatty/GoldenObserverRoute.name: D5.S1.Deficit.Beatty.GoldenObserverRoute.golden_observer_route_w_c1
D5/S1/Deficit/Beatty/GoldenObserverRoute.signature: theorem golden_observer_route_w_c1 : (∀ v : ℕ, beta v = Real.sqrt 5 * (v : ℝ) + remainder v ∧ remainder v = (phi - 1) - Int.fract (((v : ℝ) + 1) * phi) ∧ remainder v ∈ Set.Ioc (phi - 2) (phi - 1) ∧ beta (v + 1) - beta v ∈ ({phi, phi ^ 2} : Set ℝ) ∧ (beta (v + 1) - beta v = phi ↔ beatty (v + 1) - beatty v = 1)) ∧ beta 2 - beta 1 = phi
